text: Nearly all the stalls were closed. <break time="0.8s" /> And the greater part of the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Was in darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> And I recognised a silence. <break time="0.8s" /> Like that which pervades a church. <break time="0.8s" /> After a service. <break time="0.8s" /> At the door of one stall. <break time="0.8s" /> A young lady was talking and laughing. <break time="0.8s" /> With two young gentlemen. <break time="0.8s" /> And I noticed their English accents. <break time="0.8s" /> O, I never said such a thing, she said. <break time="0.8s" /> And their silly, flirting talk. <break time="0.8s" /> Went on as if I were not there. <break time="0.8s" /> Observing me. <break time="0.8s" /> The young lady came over and asked me. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether I wished to buy anything. <break time="0.8s" /> But her tone was not encouraging. <break time="0.8s" /> No, thank you, I said. <break time="0.8s" /> And I stood there for a while. <break time="0.8s" /> Pretending to be interested. <break time="0.8s" /> In her wares. <break time="0.8s" /> Knowing that my staying was useless. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I heard a voice. <break time="0.8s" /> At one end of the gallery. <break time="0.8s" /> Calling that the light was out. <break time="0.8s" /> And the upper part of the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Was now completely dark. <break time="0.8s" /> Gazing up into the darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw myself as a creature. <break time="0.8s" /> Driven and derided by vanity. <break time="0.8s" /> And my eyes burned. <break time="0.8s" /> With anguish and anger.
